aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food trucks and mobile caterers: online orders, collection times, and less repeatedly answering the same questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile caterers, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep order handling smooth and spend less time answering repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was born precisely to change this.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software available to them is designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our goal is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses really operate.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab came from a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: I founded Village Foodie, a directory that helps people discover food trucks nearby, and afterwards spent more time understanding the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks move constantly, trade at different locations, and the conditions in which they serve customers keep changing.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically, no need to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: When handing out a buzzer, add the buzzer number to the order, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers can see, showing order numbers and when they can collect.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming trading dates on your own website; each date links directly to its order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and food festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen, and the only way to keep taking orders when you lose network signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much the kitchen can cook at a time and how long it takes. Once a time slot is full, customers cannot choose it.

featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into meal deals and suggest add-ons at checkout to raise the average order value.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as WhatsApp auto-replies, for Messenger and Instagram enquiries.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens at once — front counter and kitchen — all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Set up separate logins for staff, with suitable access permissions.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose network signal, online ordering pauses so customers don't place orders you can't see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you keep taking orders offline; the web dashboard needs a network connection.

featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a deadline for items that need advance notice.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that do not show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code; scanning it opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule for you automatically — from your website, or a photo you usually post on Facebook. You just check and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically text customers when their order is ready to collect.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add the dates, places and times for each week and each event.

featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock quantity; it counts down automatically as orders come in and is set sold out automatically when it runs out.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments with a supported phone, with no need for a separate card machine.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets to a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time slot, spreading demand across the whole service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the food truck window, taking payment on your own card machine.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your trading from the browser on any phone, tablet or laptop.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once, and how long it takes. Once a collection time is full, customers cannot choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the truck — and the card machine you already have.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume you have a fixed address, stable Wi-Fi and the same opening hours every week. But you trade in different places at different times every week, with patchy or even no mobile signal. HatchGrab is built exactly for this.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose signal, online ordering pauses automatically so customers don't place orders you can't see. You can keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you normally use on Facebook or Instagram, and we fill in dates, places and times, ready to share — weekly or daily.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automatically make Facebook and Instagram posts
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers pre-order and choose a collection time. Shorter queues, and the food is ready as soon as customers arrive.
landing.does.title: Built for food trucks, not restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: "Where are you tonight?" "What desserts are there?" While you drive to your pitch or are busy at the grill, your WhatsApp replies automatically based on your menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: "Where are you tonight?" "What desserts are there?" Soon, while you drive to your pitch or are busy at the grill, your WhatsApp will reply automatically too. Messenger and Instagram to follow later.
landing.final.lede: Upload a photo or screenshot of your menu and within 60 seconds we will turn it into an ordering page you can actually use, so you can try it out. Your items, your prices. No sign-up, no credit card, nothing to install. Look first, then decide.

comparisonSuits.q.priceLow: I only trade a few days a month — which system costs the least?
